title: Open UI icon sets (Lucide, Tabler, Phosphor, Material Symbols, Font Awesome Free)
summary: Pick an open UI icon set by licence, fetch SVGs, and keep the right notices (none on screen for ISC/MIT/Apache, credit for Font Awesome).
description: Use when captions, lower thirds, explainer diagrams or Godot UI need clean interface icons. Lucide (ISC), Tabler (MIT), Phosphor (MIT) and Material Symbols (Apache-2.0) need no on-screen credit; Font Awesome Free icons are CC BY 4.0. Covers choosing a set, fetching SVGs and keeping notices.

source.notes: Describes https://github.com/iconify/icon-sets (checked 2026-10-10); contains no third-party media.
